comment: Exceptions to the helix-lint preset (#695). Every entry needs `files` (globs), `rules` and a `reason`; helixAllow throws without one and so fails `pnpm lint`. Remove an entry when its files migrate. Stylelint rules and `helix/no-raw-control` are listed under their own key.

stylelint.reason: The wordmark of the start screen is a display size above the type scale (--h-font-size-3xl is the largest step)
A fixed-size icon: the 8px dot glyph that marks a folder with changed notes
Secondary text and widgets in the note area use 0.85em so they scale with --nixe-note-font-size and the editor zoom (STYLEGUIDE.md, Typography and spacing); the type scale has fixed rem steps

eslint.reason: Dev-only spike (isDevMode), not shipped UI; kept as raw HTML, not migrated (decision of #695)

Three raw controls in the bookmarks template: the `+` button that adds a group, the inline rename `<input>` and the `×` remove button of each row; they are icon-sized custom looks beside the hx-list-row, not yet on hx-button and hx-input; migration tracked in #713, which removes this entry

Two native `<select>` pickers (range with fixed options, version with a disabled placeholder option; hx-select to replace them) and the row `Open` button in the rowActions slot (hx-button); migration tracked in #713, which removes this entry
